messages:
Anjali (CS): Quick heads-up — kicking off the econ handoff for Skylark (renewal in 28 days). Need a clean snapshot of projected token trajectory and any throttle alerts.
Devon (FinOps): Copy. I'll pull the last 60d usage curve + burn-from-activation slice. Short table in ~15m.
Sam (AE): Customer wants an ops-friendly slide for finance: one slide w/ A) current MRR impact, B) expected delta from embed rollout, C) recommended throttle knobs.
Anjali (CS): Also include 7d P95 latency cost — they care about tail pricing during bursts.
Devon (FinOps): Running quick SQL now:
```
select date, tokens_used, avg_price_per_k from billing.daily where account_id='skylark' order by date desc limit 60;
```
I'll paste the CSV when ready.
Riley (PD): FYI we shipped embed-cache last week; if enabled we estimate ~22% token drop on reranks (high confidence).
Sam (AE): I'll frame that as a non-disruptive perf win in the renewal brief.
billing-bot: Alert — account skylark triggered soft-budget-warning (threshold 80%) at 1732468200. See /billing/alerts/1732468200
Anjali (CS): Thanks bot. Devon, fold the soft-budget event into the forecast (model a throttle at 95% threshold).
Devon (FinOps): Will do. I'll model three scenarios: baseline trend, baseline + cache opt, and baseline + cache + throttle fallback. Preliminary: baseline -> +38% MoM, +cache -> +12% MoM, +throttle -> +7% MoM (customer-visible degradation <2% per our SLOs).
Anjali (CS): Solid. Sam — can you own the slide with those three scenarios and recommend next-step (enable cache + proactive alert at 65%)?
Sam (AE): Yep. Will add rollback paths and RSVP contacts (Riley for product toggles, Ops for scaling).
Riley (PD): I'll draft the toggle runbook and include a 2-week feedback loop + a tiny prompt-set to validate quality post-cache.
Anjali (CS): Capture note from last eng sync: customer observed hallucination spikes when embedding volume increases — annotate as a risk.
Devon (FinOps): CSV snippet:
```
2026-03-15,1200000,0.0009
2026-03-14,900000,0.0009
2026-03-13,1500000,0.0009
… (truncated)
```
Full export will be attached to QBR notes.
Anjali (CS): Next steps: Devon finalizes forecast + scenario numbers by EOD; Sam prepares single-slide econ summary; Riley drafts toggle + feedback runbook. I'll schedule 30m sync tomorrow to review before sending to customer.
Sam (AE): Added action items to my slide deck, ping me if you want a one-pager for finance.
Devon (FinOps): Alerting recommendation snippet: `budget_alert: 65%`, `soft_throttle: 95%`, notify cs-team+ops.
Anjali (CS): Tagging @Sam @Devon @Riley — materials in shared folder by 5pm PT. :thumbsup:
Sam (AE): :thumbsup: 
Riley (PD): 👍
billing-bot: Reminder posted to #billing-ops for threshold approval at 1732469020.
